steps.en: Install the engine into a Python environment
steps.zh: 把引擎装进 Python 环境
steps.code: uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto · pip install vllm

steps.en: Start an OpenAI-compatible server pointed at any Hugging Face model id
steps.zh: 用任意 Hugging Face 模型 ID 启动服务

steps.en: Loads the model once, then pages the KV cache into fixed-size GPU blocks as requests arrive
steps.zh: 加载一次模型，把 KV 缓存虚拟化成固定大小的页

steps.en: Point your existing OpenAI client at the endpoint
steps.zh: 把现有 OpenAI 客户端指向这个端点

steps.en: Continuously batches concurrent requests, streaming tokens and reclaiming blocks as sequences finish
steps.zh: 连续批处理并发请求，序列一结束就回收块、流式返回

value.en: OpenAI-compatible serving at datacenter throughput without writing batching or KV-cache management yourself
value.zh: 不必自己写批处理和 KV 缓存管理，就得到 OpenAI 兼容的高吞吐服务
